How to Detox From Suboxone Kim's Recipe
This is a copy of Tim's recipe, I just tweaked it a little bit.
What you need:
A shit ton of marijuana, cigarettes if you smoke, and a change of scenery, ex: cousins house, grandparents house, friend or sisters house it doesn't matter.
Vitamins: vitamin b6 and Potassium Gluconate.
I went to detox and left against medical advice after three days. I left on 4mg Suboxone, and ten mg of Valium.
Day one off suboxone: very bad, uncomfortable, body aches, everything, insomnia, etc.
Day two off suboxone: Same as first day.
Day three off suboxone: Same as second day.
Day four off suboxone: I can see light at the end of the tunnel.
Day five off suboxone: energy is coming back little by little.
Day six off suboxone: This is day six.
And through all of these five days I smoked a ton of weed, smoked cigarettes, watch movies, and chill. Marijuana therapy it works.
